config.name: vmNicLoadBalancerListenerHealthCheck.interval
config.description: the interval to check the status of the vmNic in the loadBalancerListener, in seconds

config.name: vmNicLoadBalancerListenerHealthCheck.threadNum
config.description: the number of threads used to check the status of the vmNic in the loadBalancerListener

config.name: removeUnhealthyInstance.interval
config.description: the interval to remove unhealthy instance, in seconds

config.name: removeUnhealthyInstance.threadNum
config.description: the number of threads used to remove unhealthy instance

config.name: checkTheNumberOfInstancesInTheGroup.interval
config.description: the interval to check the number of instances in the group, in seconds

config.name: autoScalingGroup.activity.retention.amount
config.description: the number of autoScalingGroup activity log retention by per group
